QUOTE: Callbacks run on the engine thread via `process_events()`, not on the monitor thread. ... `event_mutex_` guards the queue ... health events are queued and delivered on the engine thread, so consumer code never runs on the monitor thread.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that health events are queued under `event_mutex_` and that callbacks are delivered on the engine thread through `process_events()`, not on the monitor thread.
